chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who recites two surahs in one rak'ah, so he said: For every rak'ah there is one surah.

key_terms.سُورَةٌ: one surah to be recited in that unit

ai.seo_question: Can two surahs be recited in one rak'ah of an obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding recitation in salat (prayer), indicating that each rak'ah should have one surah. It is used in the context of the prohibition of reciting less than one complete surah or more than one surah in an obligatory prayer.
